# SlideSorted

> Free, plain-English PowerPoint guides. Every how-to opens with the exact click path, then covers the mistakes people make and the cases where the feature is the wrong tool.

Independent site, not affiliated with Microsoft. Each guide is checked against the current desktop build of PowerPoint and states where the Mac version differs. No accounts, no signup, no advertising.

## Guides

- [How to Use PowerPoint: The Complete Beginner's Guide](https://slidesorted.com/): Eight steps from a blank deck to a finished presentation, plus a route through the site for each skill level.
- [How to Add Animation in PowerPoint](https://slidesorted.com/how-to-add-animation-in-powerpoint): Select the object, open the Animations tab, pick an Entrance, Emphasis, Exit or Motion Path effect, then set Start to On Click, With Previous or After Previous.
- [How to Add Speaker Notes in PowerPoint](https://slidesorted.com/how-to-add-speaker-notes-in-powerpoint): View → Notes opens the pane below the slide; type there, and read the notes in Presenter View. Notes are never visible to the audience.
- [How to Add Transitions in PowerPoint](https://slidesorted.com/how-to-add-transitions-in-powerpoint): A transition belongs to the slide you arrive at, not the one you leave — the step most people get backwards. Includes Morph.
- [How to Compress a PowerPoint File](https://slidesorted.com/how-to-compress-a-powerpoint-file): Compress Media shrinks embedded video (Windows only); Compress Pictures shrinks images. Find out which one is actually making the file big first.
- [How to Embed an Excel Chart in PowerPoint](https://slidesorted.com/how-to-embed-an-excel-chart-in-powerpoint): Paste Special links, embeds, or pastes a picture of the chart — the choice decides whether the chart updates when the spreadsheet changes.
- [How to Insert a Video in PowerPoint](https://slidesorted.com/how-to-insert-a-video-in-powerpoint): Three sources — this device, Microsoft's stock library, or an online link — and which one causes "my video won't play".
- [How to Make a PowerPoint Template](https://slidesorted.com/how-to-make-a-powerpoint-template): Set slide size and theme, edit the Slide Master, then save as .potx into the Custom Office Templates folder.
- [How to Recover an Unsaved PowerPoint Presentation](https://slidesorted.com/how-to-recover-an-unsaved-powerpoint): Steps ordered by how likely they are to work; step one is File → Info → Manage Presentation → Recover Unsaved Presentations.
- [How to Use Slide Master in PowerPoint](https://slidesorted.com/how-to-use-slide-master-in-powerpoint): The parent master controls fonts, colours, backgrounds and logos on every slide at once; the layouts below it inherit.

## Tools

- [PowerPoint File Size Checker](https://slidesorted.com/powerpoint-file-size-checker): Drop a .pptx and see which files inside it are taking the space. Runs entirely in the browser — the file is never uploaded.
